title: mihulish restored & new features planned
summary: The mihulish bot returned online after a hosting issue, with more community tools planned.
description: A missing hosting dependency temporarily took mihulish offline, but the bot was restored and development continued on new knowledge and Q&A features.

body.text: mihulish returned online after a hosting-related module issue and its download-number commands became available again.
An auto-learning feature was planned to help create wiki pages and answer community questions more easily.
Work also began on a website changelog following community interest.
